instruction.text: In some situations, it is more appropriate to speak formally. Would you expect to hear formal or informal speech in this situation?

wrong.text:
Formal speech is more polite and is usually used with strangers and older people.

Informal speech is more relaxed and is usually used with friends and family.

atoms.a: Having dinner at home with your family
Talking with your friends at lunchtime
Speaking to the waiter at a posh restaurant

instruction.text: Is this sentence formal or informal?

feedback.correct: This is an example of Standard English. It follows correct grammatical rules and is considered to be the official way of writing or speaking.
This is an example of non-Standard English. It does not follow correct grammatical rules and often includes examples of slang.

atoms.a: I dunno what I wanna do.
Would you like to go for a coffee?
Please have your ticket ready for inspection.

instruction.text: Select all the greetings that are written in Standard English.
Select all the sentences that are not written in Standard English.

b: You should have brought an umbrella.
I would like to play tennis.
